# EduLedger — School & Tuition Management System

> EduLedger is a modern educational institution fee tracking, receipt generation, and payment management platform.

## Features
- Payment Collection: Record Cash and UPI fee payments with instant digital receipt generation.
- Student Ledger: Track tuition dues, payment histories, and student enrolment records.
- Reporting & Day Closings: Generate daily, monthly, and academic-year financial statements.
- Role-Based Access Control: Tailored workflows for Administrators and School/Tuition Accountants.
